title.narrative: The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS)

description.narrative: The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is a platform for generating, assessing and using evidence to support the development and implementation of cost-effective and context-specific solutions to mitigate antimicrobial resistance. The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) partners with low- and middle-income countries in their efforts to reduce drug-resistant infections. ICARS develops tailored solutions with governments and researchers who implements using ICARS funding and expertise building on Antimicrobial Resistance National Plans. ICARS aims to mitigate the immediate AMR threat, ultimately a world where drug-resistant infections no longer pose a threat.
